datasets.title: Guinea: High Resolution Population Density Maps + Demographic Estimates
datasets.description: The world's most accurate population datasets. Seven maps/datasets for the distribution of various populations in Guinea: (1) Overall population density (2) Women (3) Men (4) Children (ages 0-5) (5) Youth (ages 15-24) (6) Elderly (ages 60+) (7) Women of reproductive age (ages 15-49).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/highresolutionpopulationdensitymaps-gin]
datasets.details: To reference this data, please use the following citation: Facebook Connectivity Lab and Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University. 2016. High Resolution Settlement Layer (HRSL). Source imagery for HRSL © 2016 DigitalGlobe. Accessed DAY MONTH YEAR.' Please note that as of 2024, Meta's high resolution population density maps are no longer being updated.

entity.name: Facebook/Meta AI and Data for Good

lineage.description: Machine learning algorithms identified building footprints from commercial satellite imagery across Guinea. Population estimates derived from publicly available census data were spatially distributed to these buildings and aggregated into high-resolution gridded maps using demographic disaggregation methods developed in partnership with Columbia University, producing seven demographic-specific population density layers at sub-settlement scale.

sources.description: Machine learning-derived building footprints from satellite imagery used as the spatial foundation for population distribution mapping

sources.description: Population estimation methodology and census data integration for disaggregating baseline population counts into high-resolution demographic layers
